## Checklist (author)

- [ ] File is in `src/content/docs/entries/` and named in lowercase with no spaces
- [ ] At least one author has `emi_member: true`
- [ ] Every front-matter field is filled (`N/A` where it does not apply)
- [ ] Every section is filled
- [ ] The system boundary is described in General Description
- [ ] A figure is uploaded to `public/images/<file-name>/`, set in `figure:`, and shown in the General Description
- [ ] Data links work, or the sharing conditions are stated
- [ ] The automatic build check passed
